affected_ledger_rows: The two math-1 rows appended on 2026-10-29 at about 08:15 and 08:21 PDT (no-seven-states; algebraic endpoint) and the sharpened bracket in addendum-1.
error: Each of these writes the bracket for the supremum of PH7-realizable ratios with an OPEN right endpoint: [5935/9126, 17/20), [41/50, 17/20), [z_*, 17/20) and "(0.8204203, 0.85)". That asserts sup < 17/20. The adopted theorem excludes seven-state representations at every z >= 17/20 and therefore proves only sup <= 17/20: realizable ratios could approach 17/20 from below without a proved positive gap, and the realizable set is not known to be closed.
correction: Read every such bracket with a CLOSED right endpoint: the supremum of PH7-realizable ratios lies in [z_*, 17/20] (equivalently [41/50, 17/20] and [5935/9126, 17/20] at the weaker lower ends), i.e. in [0.8204203, 0.85]. The minimum-order statements (exactly 7 on [7/9, z_*] conditional on the six-state barrier; exactly 8 on [17/20, 8/9]; {8,9} on (8/9, 1]) are unaffected. sup = 17/20 is not excluded; sup < 17/20 would require a separate positive-gap proof.
